# Append-only evidence record (issue #115). Add new dated entries below; do not edit old ones.
# EXPERIMENTAL single-LOGIC4 HARNESS routability observations on the G1 harness fabric as
# implemented (same-index switch matrix, 4 tracks/edge, CAP_* loop-backs, scratch pad overlay of
# 8 pads, nextpnr-generic --uarch fabulous). NOT the ratified Wilton-class population (ADR-0004/0005
# are Proposed), no inter-tile routing, no timing content. Inputs to the operator's ADR-0004
# item 3 decision; they do not make that decision. See design/fabulous/corpus/README.md.
# Reproduce: flow/corpus.sh [--append-record design/fabulous/corpus/results.txt]
#            (pinned FABulous 2.2.0, OSS CAD Suite 2026-10-08: yosys 0.69+260,
#             nextpnr-0.11.1-54-g861c57be; flow/tool_versions.sh; host Icarus Verilog for sim)
# Outcome classes: success | route_fail | route_nonconvergent | capacity_packing are measured;
#   synthesis_error | topology_mismatch | tool_error | sim_fail fail the run and are never recorded
#   as unroutability. route_nonconvergent = unrouted arcs remained when the 60 s wall-clock budget
#   expired (nextpnr's router has no iteration cap); bounded-effort evidence, not a proof.
